messages:
mira: quick heads-up — ran a TPU->GPU-style TP perf sweep on 8xA100 (nvlink), small batch/seq (B=2, seq=32). seeing ~2–4ms extra time per step pinned in comm path when we pick the small-chunk kernel combo. cc @jon @sam :thinking_face:
jon: can you post the perf flame for the step? is the overhead in nccl or in our chunking layer?
mira: pasted the condensed top stacks below (trimmed):
```
step_wall: 18.6ms
- compute kernels: 12.0ms
- comm (collective): 4.1ms  <-- unexpected
- kv-cache flush/serialize: 1.8ms
flame (call stacks): ncclRecv -> ncclAllReduceRing -> our_chunk_send -> kernel_dispatch
note: when we force larger chunks the comm time drops to ~1.2ms but compute latency increases slightly
```
sam: interesting. small-chunk path + our kernel-selection heuristic might be generating a bad commshape (many tiny messages). did you try toggling NCCL_ALGO or the tree fallback?
mira: tried `NCCL_ALGO=ring` (default) vs `tree` fallback via our runtime switch. ring gives stable throughput for large messages but for these tiny msgs tree reduces latency variance. switching to tree at runtime removed ~1.6ms from comm but added ~0.3ms overhead in packing. overall win.
tess: did you correlate with KV cache hits? small seqs might trigger more kvcache lookups and serialize into separate requests.
mira: yes, kvcache contributed ~1.8ms when cold; but even with warm cache the comm hang remains. looks orthogonal.
jon: can you share the kernel-selection logs? might be choosing a low-throughput kernel for short sequences leading to poor overlap. also check our cudaStream assignment (are we serializing streams?)
mira: logs: `kernel_select: slab_v2_smallseq -> fused_matmul_8x8` then `dispatch_stream: main` (no dedicated comm overlap stream).
perf-bot: perf alert: increased allreduce latency detected in job tp-eval/2026-03-10. regression delta +1.7ms (p95).
sam: if dispatch is using main stream, NCCL may be forced to synchronize frequently. try enabling async-compute-stream and pin comm to a separate stream. also adjust chunk_size heuristic: bump threshold from 64KB -> 128KB for TP pipeline microbatches.
mira: I ran two quick experiments: (1) force tree algorithm + separate comm stream, (2) increase chunk size. results: (1) p95 step down by 1.9ms, more stable; (2) p95 down by 1.1ms but spiky when single GPU has slightly larger seq.
tess: sounds like hybrid policy needed: prefer tree for messages < 40KB, ring for > 40KB, plus ensure stream separation for overlap. also consider coalescing adjacent small sends at the chunking layer.
jon: agree. we should also add a kernel-selection rule: if selected kernel yields single-stream dispatch, prefer alternative kernel with multi-stream-friendly launch even if slightly lower FLOP efficiency. latency-sensitive workloads care more.
mira: will prototype: 1) add comm-stream assignment in runtime, 2) add msgsize->algo policy, 3) coalesce small kvcache responses for TP. aiming to run nightly sweep and update perf-bot.
sam: can you add a quick repro script? we can run on 4x and 8x clusters and compare ring/tree and stream configs. include `nccl-tests`/microbench too.
mira: will drop repro at //artifacts/tp-comm-overhang (posting after run). thanks for quick triage :thumbsup:
jon: also add a debug flag to dump `commshape` histogram per-step, would help tune coalescer.
mira: noted. I'll add `--debug-comm-hist` and post results tomorrow.
perf-bot: note: started nightly job tp-comm-overhang/227654 to collect baselines across shapes.
